entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain, and amounts may approach warning criteria. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate. Changes: Start of the Watch has been delayed to midday.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: Southeast winds may approach severe gale in exposed places, mainly north of the mountain. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Low. Changes: The chance of upgrade for this Watch has been decreased to Low.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow may settle on the road from this morning until late afternoon, where 1 to 2 cm may accumulate about the summit with snow flurries to 500 metres.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow may settle on the road from late morning until early Monday morning, where 4 to 8 cm may accumulate about the summit with lesser amounts to 500 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers are east of the summit are expected to ease this evening. Expect additional 2 to 5 cm to accumulate down to 400 metres east of the summit.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow may settle on the road from early evening until early Monday morning, where 2 to 5 cm may accumulate about and east of the summit with lesser amounts to 600 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers are expected to ease late afternoon. Expect additional 5 to 8 cm to accumulate about the summit, with lesser amounts on lower parts of the road. Light snow showers may continue into this evening.
